parameters.item/Comment: @{coalesce(body('Record_in_NXT')?['detail'], 'The recording flow did not answer. Check the gift batch in NXT before any retry.')}

properties.Text: ThisItem.'Constituent Name' & " · " & Text(ThisItem.'Gift Amount') & " $ · " & ThisItem.'Processing status'.Value

If(IsBlank(varSel), "Select a submission.",   "Reference: " & varSel.Title & Char(10) &   "Donor: " & varSel.'Constituent Name' & " (" & varSel.'Constituent ID' & ")" & Char(10) &   "Gift: " & Text(varSel.'Gift Amount') & " $, " & varSel.'Payment Type' & Char(10) &   "Coding: " & varSel.Campaign & " / " & varSel.Appeal & " / " & varSel.Fund & Char(10) &   "Payment reference: " & varSel.'Payment Reference' & Char(10) &   "Status: " & varSel.'Processing status'.Value & Char(10) &   "Review comment: " & varSel.'Review Comment')

properties.HintText: "Comment for the fundraiser (required for Return and Reject)"

properties.OnSelect: Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},     If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Submitted",         Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);         Set(varSel, cur),         Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Under Review"}, 'Reviewer Email': User().Email}));         Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Claim",             'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': cur.'Processing status'.Value, 'To Status': "Under Review",             'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});         Notify("Claimed. You are the reviewer of " & cur.Title & ".", NotificationType.Success)))

If(IsBlank(Trim(txtComment.Text)), Notify("Write a comment for the fundraiser.", NotificationType.Error),     Refresh('MCHF Submissions');     With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},         If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Under Review",             Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);             Set(varSel, cur),             Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Needs Information"}, 'Review Comment': txtComment.Text}));             Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Return",                 'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': cur.'Processing status'.Value, 'To Status': "Needs Information",                 Comment: txtComment.Text, 'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});             Reset(txtComment);             Notify(cur.Title & " returned to the fundraiser.", NotificationType.Success))))

If(IsBlank(Trim(txtComment.Text)), Notify("Write the reason for the fundraiser.", NotificationType.Error),     Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); Refresh('MCHF - Payment Log');     With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},         If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Under Review",             Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);             Set(varSel, cur),             Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Rejected"}, 'Review Comment': txtComment.Text}));             Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Reject",                 'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': cur.'Processing status'.Value, 'To Status': "Rejected",                 Comment: txtComment.Text, 'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});             If(!IsBlank(cur.'Payment Reference'),                 With({pay: LookUp('MCHF - Payment Log', Reference = cur.'Payment Reference')},                     If(!IsBlank(pay), Patch('MCHF - Payment Log', pay,                         {Status: {Value: "Unclaimed"}, 'Claimed By Name': Blank(), 'Submission Reference': Blank()}))));             Reset(txtComment); Notify(cur.Title & " rejected.", NotificationType.Success))))

Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); Refresh('MCHF - Payment Log'); With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},     If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Under Review",         Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);         Set(varSel, cur),         Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Recording in Progress"},             'Approved By Email': User().Email, 'Approved At': Now()}));         Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Approve",             'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': cur.'Processing status'.Value, 'To Status': "Recording in Progress",             'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});         If(!IsBlank(cur.'Payment Reference'),             With({pay: LookUp('MCHF - Payment Log', Reference = cur.'Payment Reference')},                 If(!IsBlank(pay), Patch('MCHF - Payment Log', pay, {Status: {Value: "Coded"}}))));         IfError('MCHF-ApproveGift'.Run(cur.ID),             Notify("The approval flow did not start. Check Historique.", NotificationType.Error),             Notify(cur.Title & " approved. Recording in NXT… Click Actualiser in about 2 minutes.", NotificationType.Success))))

If(IsBlank(Trim(txtComment.Text)), Notify("Write why the submission is cancelled.", NotificationType.Error),     Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); Refresh('MCHF - Payment Log');     With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},         If(!(cur.'Processing status'.Value in ["Submitted", "Under Review", "Needs Information"]),             Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);             Set(varSel, cur),             Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Cancelled"}, 'Review Comment': txtComment.Text}));             Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Cancel",                 'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': cur.'Processing status'.Value, 'To Status': "Cancelled",                 Comment: txtComment.Text, 'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});             If(!IsBlank(cur.'Payment Reference'),                 With({pay: LookUp('MCHF - Payment Log', Reference = cur.'Payment Reference')},                     If(!IsBlank(pay), Patch('MCHF - Payment Log', pay,                         {Status: {Value: "Unclaimed"}, 'Claimed By Name': Blank(), 'Submission Reference': Blank()}))));             Reset(txtComment); Notify(cur.Title & " cancelled.", NotificationType.Success))))
Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); Refresh('MCHF - Submission History'); If(!IsBlank(varSel), Set(varSel, LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)))

properties.Text: "Check the NXT gift batches for " & varSel.Title & " before choosing. " & First(Sort(Filter('MCHF - Submission History', 'Submission Reference' = varSel.Title), 'Action At', SortOrder.Descending)).Comment

properties.OnSelect: Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},     If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Transfer Failed",         Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);         Set(varSel, cur),         Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Added to NXT Batch"}}));         Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Gift is in NXT",             'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': "Transfer Failed", 'To Status': "Added to NXT Batch",             Comment: "Checked in NXT: " & txtComment.Text, 'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});         Reset(txtComment);         Notify(cur.Title & " marked as added to the NXT batch. Nothing was sent again.", NotificationType.Success)))

properties.Text: "Gift is not in NXT, record again"
properties.OnSelect: Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = varSel.ID)},     If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Transfer Failed",         Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error);         Set(varSel, cur),         Set(varSel, Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Processing status': {Value: "Recording in Progress"}}));         Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Gift is not in NXT, record again",             'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': "Transfer Failed", 'To Status': "Recording in Progress",             Comment: txtComment.Text, 'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});         Reset(txtComment);         IfError('MCHF-ApproveGift'.Run(cur.ID),             Notify("The approval flow did not start. Check Historique.", NotificationType.Error),             Notify(cur.Title & ": recording again. Click Actualiser in about 2 minutes.", NotificationType.Success))))

properties.Items: Filter('MCHF Submissions', 'Processing status'.Value = "Needs Information" && Author.Email = User().Email)

properties.Text: If(IsBlank(galReturned.Selected), "Select a returned submission.",   galReturned.Selected.Title & " was returned by Gift Processing:" & Char(10) & galReturned.Selected.'Review Comment')

properties.OnSelect: With({amt: Trim(txtRetAmount.Text)},   If(IsBlank(galReturned.Selected),       Notify("Select a returned submission.", NotificationType.Error),     !IsMatch(amt, "^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$") || Value(amt) <= 0,       Notify("Gift amount: a number more than 0, for example 100.00.", NotificationType.Error),     IsBlank(Trim(txtRetCampaign.Text)) || IsBlank(Trim(txtRetAppeal.Text)),       Notify("Campaign and appeal are required.", NotificationType.Error),     Refresh('MCHF Submissions'); Refresh('MCHF Fund Lines');     With({cur: LookUp('MCHF Submissions', ID = galReturned.Selected.ID),           lines: Filter('MCHF Fund Lines', 'Submission Reference' = galReturned.Selected.Title)},       If(cur.'Processing status'.Value <> "Needs Information",           Notify(cur.Title & " is now " & cur.'Processing status'.Value & ". Nothing was changed.", NotificationType.Error),         Value(amt) <> cur.'Gift Amount' && CountRows(lines) > 1,           Notify("This gift is split across several funds. Ask Gift Processing before changing the amount.", NotificationType.Error),         Value(amt) < Coalesce(cur.Fees, 0),           Notify("The gift amount can't be less than the fees (" & Text(cur.Fees) & ").", NotificationType.Error),         Patch('MCHF Submissions', cur, {'Gift Amount': Value(amt),           'Net Amount': Value(amt) - Coalesce(cur.Fees, 0),           Campaign: Trim(txtRetCampaign.Text), Appeal: Trim(txtRetAppeal.Text),           'Processing status': {Value: "Submitted"}});         If(CountRows(lines) = 1, Patch('MCHF Fund Lines', First(lines), {Amount: Value(amt)}));         Patch('MCHF - Submission History', Defaults('MCHF - Submission History'), {Title: "Resubmit",           'Submission Reference': cur.Title, 'From Status': "Needs Information", 'To Status': "Submitted",           Comment: "Amount " & Text(cur.'Gift Amount') & " → " & amt & "; Campaign " & cur.Campaign & " → " & Trim(txtRetCampaign.Text) & "; Appeal " & cur.Appeal & " → " & Trim(txtRetAppeal.Text),           'Actor Email': User().Email, 'Action At': Now()});         Refresh('MCHF Submissions');         Notify(cur.Title & " was resubmitted.", NotificationType.Success)))))
